Plaint case is that, suit land was originally belonged to Ibrahim, Solim Ullah, Amzad Ali, Anar Ali, Esmat Ali Alio Kha and Abdul Aziz and it has been recorded in their names in different R.S. dogs in different quantum against their names. Khatian has been finally published in their names. Abdur Rashid died leaving two sons, Abdul Munnaf and Abdul Motaleb and wife, Saleha Khatun. Plaintiff No. 4 mutated his name and after loan taken from Bangladesh Bank, Chittagong Branch, constructed 3 storied pucca building, possessing himself and also through monthly tenants. Abdul Motaleb and others while in possession of remaining land, transferred the said land to one, Mod. Jorip Hossain, son of Moulavi Abdul Jabbar by registered deed No. 4088 and 21.03.1979 and by deed No. 4093 dated 22.03.1979. Jorip Hossain while in possession of his purchased land, transferred the said land to Abdul Jobbar, son of late Torab Ali by registered deed Nos. 6457 and 6458 dated 08.04.1984 and deed Nos. 6631 and 6633 dated 10.04.1984. While said Siddique Ahmed, Saleha Khatun and Jomir Ahmed enjoying the said land having title thereto, by registered deed No. 5833 dated 18.11.1963 transferred 141/6 decimals of land in favour of plaintiff No. 2 and delivered possession. P.S. khatian has been published in the name of plaintiff No. 2. Plaintiff No. 2 by installing a Rice Mills and also constructed some shop rooms, possessing the said land through himself and through tenant. Siddique Ahmed while in possession died, leaving heirs in defendant Nos. 6-13 who constructed 4 storied pucca building, two one storied buildings, one tin shed house over 13 decimals of land and B.S. khatian has been finally published in their names. Arabia Khatun died childless. Hamidannessa died leaving two sons, Jamir Ahmed and Jahur Ahmed and one daughter, Somana Khatun. Somana Khatun transferred her share by registered deed No. 1510 dated 05.03.1973 to Manir Ahemd and Jahur Ahmed and delivered possession, B.S. khatian has been finally published in their names. Jamir Ahmed died unmarried and his property devolved upon his brother, plaintiff No. 14. Plaintiff No. 14 constructed one storied pucca building, shop room and tin shed houses on 12 decimals of land. Olior Kha was the owner of R.S. khatian No. 322 and R.S. dag No. 831 died, leaving two sons, Karim Khan and Sultan Khan, three daughters, Sabura Khatun, Fajila Khatun and Saleha Khatun. Karim Khan died leaving Ferdous Khan to inherit his share. Sultan Kha died leaving son, Nur Mohammad Khan, three daughters, Sacra Khatun, Rahima Khatun, Hazera Khatun end wife, Nur Khatun. Sabura Khatun died leaving three daughters, Habiza Khatun, Sapeya Khatun and Halima Khatun and 2 sons, Abdul Baki and Abdul Jabbar, Habiza Khatun died leaving son, Khairuzzamin Sofeyea Khatun died leaving two sons, Habib Ullah, Anwar Ullah and daughter, Ameria Khatun. Fazila Khatun and others while in possession, transferred 4.5 decimals of land of dag No. 831 and B.S. dag No. 773 along with R.S. dag Nos. 832 and 833 in favour of Md. Iman Hossain by registered kabala No. 19343 dated 06.11.1984 and delivered possession. Iman Hossain died, leaving plaintiff No. 15. S. khatian has been finally published in their names. Plaintiff Nos. 6-13 constructed 4 storied building and possessing the same by himself and through monthly tenant. Abdul Aziz while in possession of land of C.S. dug No. 814 and R.S. dag No. 778 of R.S. khatirm No. 322 by registered kabala No. 3010 dated 21.07.1930 transferred to Nazu Miah, P.S. khatian has been finally published in the name of Nazu Miah. Nazu Miah died leaving son, Amir Hossain and daughter, Sufia Khatun. Amir Hossain transferred 1 kara land by registered deed No. 13586 dated 20.08.1981 if favour of Amir Ahmed and delivered possession. Amir Hossain and Sofia Khatun transferred 2 kara 5 kranti land in favour of Amir Ahmed by registered deed No. 13537 dated 20.08.1981. Amir Ahmed mutated his name and by registered deed No. 833 dated 17.06.1995 transferred his purchased 7 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 16 who mutated his name and mortgaged his purchased land to Bangladesh Bank, Chattagong Branch and constructed two storied building and possessing the same by himself and through tenant. Amir Hossain transferred his remaining 4 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 17-20 by registered deed No 8391 and 8438 dated 08.04.1983. Plaintiff Nos. 17-20 constructed semi puma homestead and possessed the same through tenant. Amir Hossain also transferred some land from remaining land by registered deed No. 3492 dated 23.02.1985 and delivered possession. Monir Ahmed while in possession enjoying his purchased land, transferred said land to plaintiff No. 22, Badiul Alam by registered deed No. 1895 17.12.1985 and by registered deed No. 18187 dated 17.10.1985 transferred 4 decimals of land. Plaintiff No. 21 constructed semi puma homestead and possessing purchased land by himself and through tenant and B.S. khatian has been published in his name. Amir Hossain died leaving two sons and 5 daughters. Rahmatullah and others by registered deed No. 1286 dated 27.11.1989 transferred his land to Sufia Khatun, who died leaving defendant Nos. 22-31 who inherited the said property having title of Sufia Khatun. Plaintiff No. 22-31 constructed semi puma house and possessing through tenant.

Building Finance Corporation, defendant No. 14 and after taking loan, constructed 5 storied pucca building and possessing the same himself and through tenant. Nos. 705 and 716 dated 16.06.1988 and registered deed Nos. 747, 748, 749 dated 29.06.1988 and registered deed No. 2435 dated 16.06.1994.14 decimals of land was transferred in favour of plaintiff No. 36 who constructed 4 storied building and possessing the some by himself and through tenant.  7. It appeals that suit was filed on 08.04.2008. Plaintiffs filed all the khatians and registered deeds along with plaint, plaintiffs also filed application under Order XXVI Rule 29 of the Code of Civil Procedure for inspection as to, whether the structures as mentioned in the plaint are situated in the suit land or not. Assistant Commissioner submitted report on 10.5.2002 finding that on the suit land there are structures of plaintiffs.
